exposure: Prophylactic antibiotic use at caesarean delivery
Prophylactic antibiotic use for Group B streptococcal infection
Infants whose mother had anaphylaxis before delivery
prophylactic use of antibiotics for Group B streptococcal infection
cohort: Pregnant women in the UK who experienced anaphylaxis between October 2012 and September 2015
finding: Anaphylaxis in pregnancy is rare (1.6 per 100,000 maternities), often due to antibiotic reactions, and associated with serious maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that twelve women experienced anaphylaxis following prophylactic antibiotic use during cesarean delivery.
